mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation( customer_name, movie_id, seat_number, ticket_count, reservation_status) values( #{customerName}, #{movieId}, #{seatNumber}, #{ticketCount}, #{reservationStatus} )
mapper.update:
UPDATE reservation SET reservation_date = #{reservationDate}, seat_number = #{seatNumber}, ticket_count = #{ticketCount}, reservation_status = #{reservationStatus}
reservation_id = #{reservationId}
mapper.select: SELECT r.reservation_id, r.customer_name, r.movie_id, m.movie_title, m.movie_genre, r.reservation_status, r.reservation_date, r.seat_number, r.ticket_count, m.ticket_price, m.ticket_price * r.ticket_count as total_price from reservation r INNER JOIN movie m on r.movie_id = m.movie_id
